failure_reason: v26.06 ContactListener binding did not expose native IDs, points, or normals
fact: The official v26.06 binary created ContactListener, but its Python binding exposed no getter methods. A 20-step planar wall-contact audit consequently produced no Python-readable native pair identity, contact point, or contact normal.
inference: The R1 formal contact signal cannot be constructed with the validated official SofaPython3 runtime; no Oracle threshold was fitted or frozen and later stages were not run.
unknown: Whether a C++ listener adapter or a different officially exposed native-contact API can provide the required per-contact identity remains untested. Held-out capability and unified-passage behavior remain untested.
